name: Kalyan Jewellers India Limited
reason: Kalyan Jewellers India Ltd. is interesting right now due to its exceptional financial performance in Q4 FY26 and its ongoing expansion strategies. The company reported a significant surge in Profit After Tax (PAT) by 118.28 year-over-year to 4,095.03 million, alongside a robust 66.22 year-over-year growth in revenue for the same quarter. This strong earnings momentum, coupled with "massive expansion" plans, indicates a genuine catalyst for potential future growth.
